articles.title: Physical AI is exposing a data sovereignty gap (Reader Forum)
articles.raw_content: As connected vehicles, robots, and other physical AI systems cross borders, data sovereignty becomes about more than storage. Curtis Govan at floLIVE argues regulators and operators must address “network sovereignty”…
articles.summary: La soberanía de datos trasciende el almacenamiento, abarcando también la "soberanía de red" para vehículos y sistemas conectados.

articles.title: AI Conquered Coding. Fast Food Is Next
articles.raw_content: Your next drive-thru order might be taken by a bot. And you might not even notice.
articles.summary: Los pedidos en los restaurantes de autoservicio podrían ser atendidos por bots, sin que los clientes lo noten.

articles.title: A Marc Benioff-backed startup thinks AI can solve the AI deployment problem
articles.raw_content: June emerged from stealth today with a $20 million pre-seed round to make AI adoption simpler.
articles.summary: June sale de la clandestinidad con una ronda de pré-seed de 20 millones de dólares para simplificar la adopción de la inteligencia artificial.
